questions.question: What are the two planning modes available for portfolio planning in ServiceNow?

explanation.correct: On the Portfolio form, you can set the Portfolio Planning field to Advanced or Simple. Depending on your selection, the portfolio workbench is populated with the appropriate planning steps.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Basic and Expert are not the portfolio planning mode options
Standard and Premium are not portfolio planning modes
Manual and Automatic are not portfolio planning modes

source.excerpt: On the Portfolio form, you can set the Portfolio Planning field to Advanced or Simple.

questions.question: What can you analyze using the Capacity tab in Portfolio Planning? (Choose THREE)

options.text: Resource capacity needs across the organization by group, role, and skill
Supply of resources and demand of work in the portfolio

explanation.correct: The Capacity tab provides portfolio managers a comprehensive view of capacity, allocations, and utilization. You can view resource capacity for prioritized items, understand capacity needs by group, role, and skill, and effectively forecast the supply of resources and demand of work.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incident volume trends are part of ITSM analytics, not portfolio planning
Change request approval rates are part of Change Management, not portfolio planning

source.excerpt: View resource capacity for prioritized items. Understand the resource capacity needs and estimates across your organization by using key attributes such as group, role, and skill. Effectively forecast the supply of resources and the demand of work.

questions.question: What is the first step in both Simple and Advanced planning modes for a portfolio?

options.text: Select the fiscal period and set targets

explanation.correct: The first step in both Simple and Advanced planning for a portfolio is to select the fiscal period for the data you want to work with, then set the target amounts for both operating and capital expenses.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Budget plan creation comes after selecting fiscal period and setting targets
Selecting demands and projects comes after the fiscal period is selected
Forecast planning is part of advanced mode and comes later in the process

source.excerpt: Select the fiscal period and set targets. The first step in both Simple and Advanced planning for a portfolio is to select the fiscal period.

questions.question: What does the warning icon indicate when shown next to a planning item in the Capacity screen?

options.text: Over utilized resources, planning items with actual dates, or items with no resource assignments
The item is ready for deployment

explanation.correct: Warning icons in the Capacity screen help identify over utilized resources, planning items with actual dates (in-progress items that cannot be adjusted), and planning items or resource groups with no resource assignments.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Approval status is not indicated by warning icons
Deployment readiness is not what warning icons indicate
Budget status is shown through financial widgets, not these warning icons

source.excerpt: Use the warning icons to easily identify the over utilized resources, planning items with actual dates, and the planning items or resource groups with no resource assignments.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the Gantt bar in the Capacity screen is TRUE?

I. You can move the Gantt bar to adjust planned dates based on resource availability.
II. Planning items with actual dates (in-progress) cannot be adjusted.
III. The Gantt bar is view-only and cannot be modified.
IV. Only administrators can move Gantt bars.

explanation.correct: You can move the Gantt bar of a planning item to adjust planned dates depending on available resource capacity. However, planning items with actual dates (indicated by an in-progress icon) cannot be adjusted for resource availability.

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Gantt bar is interactive and can be moved, not view-only
Moving Gantt bars is not restricted to administrators
Statement III is false; the Gantt bar can be modified

source.excerpt: Move the Gantt bar of a planning item to adjust the planned dates depending on the available resource capacity. Planning items with actual dates, indicated with in-progress icon, cannot be adjusted.
